1941–1945 · commission, advance, capture

Regions
Commission battlegroups at harbors and divisions at factories. Select an allied harbor or factory to open its yard. Fleets carrying landing craft can invade coastal land. Each moves 2 territories through friendly ground or 1 into neutral, and fights when it reaches enemy ground. Japan moves by the same rules when you end your turn.
